intent: Part-to-whole share for a handful of segments, as a donut or solid pie.
useWhen: Rough share at a glance for up to six segments
Dashboard tiles where proportion matters more than precise ranking
doNotUseWhen: More than six segments without folding into Other

data.note: { label: string, value: number, color?: string }[]

animate.note: Slices sweep in clockwise from 12 o'clock when the chart first appears. Runs once on mount; data changes do not replay it. Off under prefers-reduced-motion; the final state shows without JS

requirements: Title exposed on the figure when provided
Slices expose name, value, and percent on the hit target
Legend highlight matches slice hover; tooltip is supplementary
Table toggle keeps values readable in table view
animate is decorative only: no motion under prefers-reduced-motion, and hover, focus, legend and table work during the entrance

doNot: Do not invent local chart wrappers
Do not add chart-library compound APIs
snippet: <PieChart title="Properties by status" variant="donut" data={[{ label: 'Listed', value: 256 }]} />
